N1_CALLBACKS.text: You questioned the envoy; his warning puts guards on the west stair.
You kept the warning within the Order; the ambush teams are already in place.
You copied the Archives to a hidden colony; one sealed index returns.
You kept the traitor list; the names narrow this search.
You opened the Ossus vault; its map marks a safer route.
You took in the Imperial defector; her report identifies a patrol.
You sheltered the Taris refugees; they warn you of a tunnel.
You honored the Mandalorian duel; the clan sends a scout.
You made a deal with Saresh; his promised name reaches the Temple.
You tracked Eleena Daru; her shuttle trace cuts through the noise.
You posted Temple Guards at the docks; their watch catches a signal.
You let the Hutt hold the schedule; the enemy now knows the patrol gaps.
You believed Kira’s vision; she recognizes the shape of this attack.
You let Tor release Kessra; a former enemy passes on a warning.
You allowed Tor’s revenge; the silence between you follows this vote.
You paid Ilsa’s debts; she brings the Council an unaltered report.
You opened Bren’s clinic; its patients know who crossed the lower city.
You sent Grak as envoy; Clan Ordo answers his call.
You sent trackers after the lone Sith; their last coordinates remain on file.
You warned the Senate about Ro; the Beacon crew has time to prepare.
